payload.core_composition_summary: Offline queries sorted by k, union-find on sorted adjacent differences to compute maximum reachable sum from initial items
payload.rationale: Sorting prepares ordered items and edges; greedy incremental merging (DSU) expands reachable sets as k increases, computing max total cost efficiently.
